stem.en: Which one of these does the GEMINI app NOT give a fisher?

text.en: Alerts on high waves and strong winds

feedback.en: The app does give these alerts.
The app does give these advisories.

text.en: Where every other boat is right now

feedback.en: Yes. Everything the app gives is about the sea and its dangers, not about other boats.

text.en: How deep the sea is, from bathymetry data

feedback.en: The app does give bathymetry data.

explanation.en: The app gives alerts on high waves and strong winds, cyclone and tsunami warnings, potential fishing zone advisories, current speeds, bathymetry data, mapping and risk management information. It is not a list of where other boats are.

hints.en: Every item on the app is about the sea itself.
